differences: The authors' time column puts the MRI frames 65-67 ms apart (about 15.0-15.4 frames per second), where the paper gives an acquisition time of 60 ms per frame (16.67 Hz); sample_rate_hz is computed from the authors' time column.
The runs span 93.2-97.6 s from their first to their last frame time, where the paper says scans lasted 88-98 s; the time columns may not cover the whole scan.

The shared R script labels the frames W1-W6 and by task in blocks of three consecutive files per whistler, which does not follow the order of its own file list (all six continuous runs first); participants and tasks here come from the file names.
